opening.argument: Buying OneCoin packages and participating through sponsored members are presented as routes to points, bonuses, and commissions. Package level determines eligibility for multiple generations of bonuses, and the speaker attributes a direct commission to a partner's upgrade. He also claims that reaching a platform threshold duplicates tokens. These recruitment-linked rewards support a finding of a scam, while the accuracy and economic value of the bonus and token claims remain unverified.
